9.5.1 HostEnqueuePromiseJob ( job, realm )

The host-defined abstract operation HostEnqueuePromiseJob takes arguments job (a Job Abstract Closure) and realm (a Realm Record or null) and returns unused.

An implementation of HostEnqueuePromiseJob must schedule the execution of job after all currently running execution contexts have completed.

Hosts are not required to preserve FIFO ordering across distinct realms in all cases.
